totpauth.login.not_registered: You are not registered yet. Ask an admin to approve you first.
totpauth.login.already_auth: You are already authenticated this session.
totpauth.login.bad_code_secret: Invalid code, and it doesn't match this server's secret at all. Remove this entry from your app and re-add it from the key shown by /2fa (copy the Secret rather than scanning).
totpauth.login.bad_code_clock: Invalid code: the server clock is out of sync by ~%ss. Ask the admin to sync the server time (NTP) - TOTP needs it within ~30s.
totpauth.login.too_fast: Wait a second before trying another code.
totpauth.approve.already_enrolled: %s is already enrolled. Run /2fa reset %s first if you want to re-issue a secret.
totpauth.approve.sent: Approved %s. Their secret was sent to them privately.
totpauth.approve.on_join: Approved %s. Their secret will be shown the next time they join.
totpauth.reset.player_notice: Your 2FA registration was reset by an admin. You'll need to be approved again.
totpauth.join.trusted_ip: Welcome back - authenticated automatically from your trusted IP.
totpauth.join.premium: Welcome - your Minecraft account was verified, so no 2FA code is needed.
totpauth.join.pending: Access is restricted - you are pending admin approval. Please wait.
totpauth.join.need_2fa: This server requires 2FA. Authenticate with /2fa login <code>.
totpauth.kick.timeout: You took too long to authenticate. Reconnect and run /2fa login <code>.
totpauth.secret.intro: An admin approved your access. Set up two-factor authentication:
totpauth.secret.step2: 2. Scan this QR code (or use the key / link beneath it):
totpauth.hover.suggest: Click to put this in your chat box
